Corrective Actions Prioritise route-diversity build-out for the Pune regional trunk given increased customer density (target: 6 months, capital planning required). Increase on-call splicing technician coverage for the region to at least two available resources (target: 30 days). Preventive Actions Longer-term preventive measures are tracked alongside the corrective actions above and reviewed at the next governance cycle. Monitoring Changes Monitoring thresholds/alerts relevant to this failure mode are reviewed and updated where the investigation identified a detection gap. Ownership Action 2 completed; Action 1 submitted for capital budget approval; owner: Network Infrastructure team.
